points.statement: Robust planning is achieved by adaptively learning dependencies and revising inaccurate ones through analogy.
points.quote: Firstly, Section 3.1 details how ADL enables robust planning by adaptively learning and revising inaccurate dependencies by analogy.

points.statement: Robustness is enhanced by remembering past operation outcomes to guide reliable step-by-step planning and trigger revision of inaccurate dependencies.
points.quote: Secondly, Section 3.2 explains how FFOM further enhances robustness by remembering past operation outcomes to guide reliable step-by-step planning and trigger revision of inaccurate dependencies.

points.statement: Dependency learning is accelerated by guiding the agent to strategically choose unexperienced items as goals based on difficulty and diversity.
points.quote: Lastly, Section 3.3 details how DEX accelerates the dependency learning by guiding the agent to strategically select unexperienced items as goals to pursue, based on difficulty and diversity.
